summary.intent: Execute all 9 plans of Phase 73 ('shared-write-navigation-correctness-web') using wave-based parallel worktree execution, discovering plans, grouping into dependency-respecting waves, spawning subagents per plan, merging results, and driving the phase through verification and completion.
summary.outcome: All 9 plans across 3 waves executed successfully in isolated worktrees and merged with clean typecheck/test gates; goal-backward verification found one real SC4 bug (missing publishedNode in a refresh-write-access reseed call), which was fixed, re-verified (7/7 SC passed), and the phase was marked complete as the final phase of milestone v2.0.

repo: Monorepo cross-package types resolve via built dist/ (gitignored), so fresh worktrees need pnpm install + build of the crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk chain before typecheck works.

Full pnpm test includes live-API sdk integration tests that false-fail without a running API; post-merge/regression gates should scope to typecheck + affected packages' infra-free unit suites instead.

apps/web shared-write hooks (useSharedWriteOps.ts, useSharedNavigation.ts, useSharedNavigationActions.ts) are a hotspot for undeclared cross-plan file overlaps even when plans declare non-overlapping files_modified.

seedActiveSharedFolder falls back to PLACEHOLDER_PUBLISHED_NODE (empty readSealed) when publishedNode is omitted, causing unsealNode to throw a GCM decrypt error — any new call site seeding shared-folder state must pass a real publishedNode, mirroring existing call sites.

code.finding: refreshCurrentDepthWriteKey's seedActiveSharedFolder call omitted publishedNode (unlike the other 4 call sites at lines 268, 351, 410, 540), causing the WRITE-03 refresh-access retry to throw an unclassified decrypt error instead of reaching publishNodeFn's tombstone/success classification. Fixed in commit d3c39c06e by passing getSdkClient().getSharedFolderState(currentShareId)?.publishedNode ?? PLACEHOLDER_PUBLISHED_NODE.

73-06 made an undeclared comment-only edit near resolveChildNodeId (renaming a stray doc-comment reference to the deleted resolveFolderIpnsPrivateKey helper) that overlapped with 73-04's body edits to the same function; git's 3-way merge resolved it cleanly with no conflict.

workflow: Executor-reported <worktree_metadata> expected_base can be the agent's own post-commit tip rather than the true fork base (observed with 73-05); the orchestrator should trust its own captured EXPECTED_BASE and verify via merge-base rather than the executor's self-report.
When two Wave 3 agents work in the same hook family but declare non-overlapping files, explicitly scoping each agent to its declared files in the dispatch prompt prevented a merge conflict.

A subagent (73-08) deferred a live e2e run because starting a second dev-server stack in parallel with a sibling worktree agent risked port contention (:3000/:5173) — this exact gap became the source of the real SC4 bug the verifier caught, showing live e2e coverage matters even under worktree parallelism constraints.
Re-scoping the verifier to just the closed gap (rather than re-running full goal-backward verification) is an efficient pattern for gap-closure confirmation.
A 'commit_failed' report from the tracking-commit helper can be a false negative — worth confirming via git log/git status before treating it as a real failure.

friction: Post-merge gate step's default build/test commands were empty, forcing manual reasoning about which scoped commands (typecheck + specific package unit tests) were safe substitutes for the full monorepo suite.
Exit-code capture broke due to a shell pipe during the first typecheck gate run, requiring a re-run to confirm the gate actually passed.

73-06's comment-only edit to useSharedWriteOps.ts was an undeclared file overlap with 73-04 that the pre-spawn intra-wave overlap check couldn't catch since it wasn't in 73-06's declared files_modified.
73-08 could not safely run its WRITE-03 e2e test live due to port contention with the concurrently running 73-09 worktree, deferring critical verification that later surfaced as a real bug.
Inline node-based status parsing scripts had syntax errors twice (once for the tdd gate check, once for phase.complete), requiring cleaner re-runs with output captured to a file.
open_items: Live rotation-ux.spec.ts WRITE-03 e2e run is still only noted as a recommended non-blocking CI/manual confirmation step, not yet executed after the SC4 fix.
Formal v2.0 milestone archive/close-out (via /gsd-complete-milestone) was left undone — PROJECT.md was only updated to note Phase 73 completion and milestone readiness, not formally archived.
SHARE-WRITE-KEY gap (write-share key threading) referenced in prior memory as open may now be substantially addressed by 73-07/73-08/73-09 — worth re-checking whether that memory entry is stale.
